subject.title: [Feature]: Generate and update openclaw.json JSON schema on bootstrap/update

question: Should OpenClaw accept default-on local editor-schema sidecar creation and root `$schema` stamping during OpenClaw-owned config writes, and which sidecar filename should become the product contract?
rationale: The request changes generated config artifacts and may add or alter config surface, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and not safe for automation to decide alone.

options.title: Accept the newer PR shape
options.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 or an equivalent implementation that preserves current config writer invariants and uses the accepted filename/default contract.

options.title: Make schema maintenance explicit
options.body: Keep manual schema export as the default and ask for an opt-in command or setting if maintainers do not want config writes to create sidecar artifacts automatically.

options.title: Reject automatic artifacts
options.body: Keep `openclaw config schema` as the supported workflow and close the linked implementation PRs if default-on local files are not part of the product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept the newer PR shape
recommendation.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 or an equivalent implementation that preserves current config writer invariants and uses the accepted filename/default contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config writer and validation history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
